# Official Partner

> Official Partner is a creative studio from Montreal that designs and builds websites, from web design and animation to development, for brands around the world. It was founded by Samuel Charpentier and Simon Langlois.

The studio works with brands and agencies in Canada, the United States, the United Kingdom, France, the Netherlands, Portugal, Sweden and Australia. On some projects Official Partner does the design and the build; on others a design or branding agency leads and brings the studio in for the web development. The client named for each project below is the one who hired Official Partner.

## Pages

- [Home](https://www.officialpartner.work/): selected projects, services and what clients say
- [About](https://www.officialpartner.work/about): the studio, its services, recognition and collaborators
- [Archives](https://www.officialpartner.work/archives): every project with its client, industry and year; each case study opens at /archives?project=<slug>
- [Contact](https://www.officialpartner.work/contact): hello@officialpartner.work
- [Drawings](https://www.officialpartner.work/drawings): drawings sent by visitors from the canvas at the bottom of every page

## Services

- Digital design
- Web development
- Web animations
- Copywriting
- User experience
- Interactive storytelling
- Creative direction

## Recognition

Work by the studio and its founders has been recognized by Awwwards, The Dieline, Type Directors Club, ADC Young Ones, Applied Arts, GD USA, Grafika, Idea, It's Nice That, The Brand Identity and Behance.

## Contact

- Email: hello@officialpartner.work
- Location: Montreal, Quebec, Canada
- Languages: English and French
